rationale.text: A visible email field has only a placeholder: no aria-labelledby, aria-label, title, associated label or label ancestor. Each condition of the test needs one of these (the adjacent-button condition too needs a hidden label, aria-label, aria-labelledby or title), and a placeholder is none of them, so the field meets no condition. The custom check faults it (step 2) through a link whose fault means failure, so the finding is failed at both levels.

citations.quote: Chaque champ de formulaire vérifie-t-il une de ces conditions
